en-US: Open Task Center with existing conversations. In Notes, select several documents, move them to Trash, then search for and restore one. Open New Task and swipe the empty welcome area. If you have a paired device, sync a shared conversation with workspace files enabled.
zh-Hans: 有历史会话时打开任务中心。在手记里多选文档并移到回收站，再搜索并恢复一篇。打开「新建任务」，上下拖动空白欢迎区。如已配对设备，可同步一个开启了工作区文件共享的会话。
